source.frame_pts_duration_hash_format: ASCII rows: pts:duration\n, in presentation order

evidence.control_model: One approved subscription proposal followed by a fixed complete storage sequence; not per-skill GPT closed-loop control

geometry.coordinate_convention: Crop xyxy is half-open; overlay rectangle xyxy is inclusive
geometry.method: Every decoded frame: find first blue-gray sky row jointly at x=250,450,650; reject any top other than 177 or 66
geometry.scaling: Isotropic fit to width 900, nearest-integer height, vertically centered; no workcell cropping
geometry.overlay_presence: Source pixel x=43,y=scene_top+25 has all RGB channels below 65
geometry.original_overlay_box: Approximately x=38..179, y=scene_top+12..67; rounded original opaque box retained
geometry.hidden_pixels: No reconstruction or inpainting; only original opaque overlay text region is replaced

timing.policy: One output frame per original decoded frame; original integer PTS and durations supplied to encoder/muxer in original time base
timing.native_capture_vs_encoded_source: Evidence reports 1701 native captures over 88.72879910469055 s; actual original MP4 contains 1779 frames at 20 fps over 88.95 s. This presentation preserves that encoded MP4, not unrecoverable native capture timestamps.
timing.phase_display: Static sequence reference only, never a live phase indicator
timing.alignment_ambiguity: Evidence phases and drawer_motion use simulation time. execute_video_offset_s alone does not establish exact simulation-to-encoded-frame phase alignment; no phase timing is guessed.
timing.rounding: Original and output container time bases are recorded above; integer source PTS are passed without speed conversion. Scene height rounding affects only spatial scale, not timestamps.

qa: Final playback, language, and timing QA belong to the integrating parent; no such verification is claimed here
